fields.name: sign-in-btn-text
fields.label: Sign In Button Text
fields.description: The text to be shown on the Sign in button, default is Sign In.

fields.name: logo-image
fields.label: Logo Image
fields.description: Logo image to display above the sign-in form

fields.name: logo-image-alt
fields.label: Logo Image Alt Text
fields.description: Alt text for the logo image

fields.name: sign-in-redirect-url
fields.label: Sign-In Redirect URL
fields.description: Page to redirect to after successful sign-in. Leave empty to stay on the home page.

fields.name: create-account-url
fields.label: Create Account URL
fields.description: Page for the 'Create an account' link. Use a full AEM path (e.g. /content/<site-name>/language-masters/<language-node>/registration).

fields.name: buttondata
fields.label: Button Data Sheet
fields.description: AEM sheet path whose key/value rows are sent on submit

fields.name: custom-class
fields.label: Custom class
fields.description: Space-separated class names to add to the block
